name: Gegemoon 7D Teeth Whitening Strips | Professional 7-Day Whitening Kit | Enamel Safe Teeth Whitening Strips | Deep Stain Removal | Mint Flavor | 7 Pairs
description:
Achieve a brighter, healthier-looking smile with Gegemoon 7D Teeth Whitening Strips. Specially formulated with an advanced whitening gel, these professional strips help penetrate tooth enamel to reduce stains caused by coffee, tea, tobacco, wine, and everyday foods. The flexible strips comfortably fit both upper and lower teeth, providing secure adhesion for even whitening while remaining gentle on enamel. With a simple 30-minute daily application, this 7-day whitening treatment offers an easy and convenient way to enhance your smile at home.

Key Features
Professional 7-day teeth whitening treatment
Advanced whitening formula helps reduce deep stains
Helps remove stains from coffee, tea, tobacco, and wine
Enamel-safe and gentle whitening formula
Flexible strips fit both upper and lower teeth comfortably
Secure adhesive for effective whitening application
Refreshing mint flavor for a clean feeling
Easy 30-minute daily treatment
Comfortable, mess-free peel-and-apply design
Suitable for home teeth whitening routine

Product Specifications
Brand: Gegemoon
Product Type: Teeth Whitening Strips
Quantity: 7 Pairs (14 Strips)
Net Weight: 2.5g (Approx.)
Flavor: Mint
Whitening Technology: 7D

How to Use
Brush and dry your teeth before application
Open the foil pouch with dry hands
Peel the strips from the backing liner
Apply the lower strip with the gel side against your teeth
Align with the gum line and press gently to secure
Fold the remaining strip behind the teeth
Repeat the same process with the upper strip
Leave on for approximately 30 minutes
Remove and discard the strips after use
Rinse your mouth thoroughly

Safety Information
For oral use only
Do not swallow the strips
Not suitable for children under 12 years of age
Not recommended for pregnant women
Do not use on irritated gums or mouth ulcers
Avoid contact with eyes
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
Keep out of reach of children
